app.title: 16-bit Windows (Windows 1.x, 2.x, 3.0, 3.1, etc.) on 64-bit Windows
app.author: doener
app.description: Wine-based emulator that runs 16‑bit Windows applications on 64‑bit Windows systems.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run build script to install winevdm
Launch winevdm and run a classic 16‑bit Windows demo application, verify exit code 0
Measure launch latency for the demo app
Run a batch of 10 different 16‑bit apps and log startup times
